submitted.rationale: Index 12 (Co0.53Sb0.47) gave the highest measured EQE, 0.0198%. XRD shows a single rutile-type phase there. At the Sb-rich end, index 18 has a second phase and gave much lower EQE (0.00084%). At the Co-rich end, index 6 is still single-phase rutile but its EQE was about zero, so the activity peaks near the middle of the composition line.
